_doc: The sea slugs' taxonomic groups, the headings their families sit under on the Learn page (Pierre, 2026-11-16 ~15:43 Manila: "organiser même proprement les familles, en regroupant en groupes taxonomiques logiques. Notamment en séparant les \"vrais\" nudibranches des autres limaces de mers"; the grouping confirmed ~15:45, "parfait !": Nudibranchia first in two blocks, Doridina then Cladobranchia, then the other sea slugs by order). Hand-kept, read by tools/seaslug_game.py (seaslug.json taxa and each family's tgroup), never written by a tool. From WoRMS's classification of each family (AphiaClassificationByAphiaID, read 2026-11-16; rule C2: a published classification, never ours): Nudibranchia's suborders Doridina and Cladobranchia; Sacoglossa is a superorder in WoRMS (no order above its families), the others orders. iNaturalist places the Cladobranchia families in five suborders instead (Aeolidina, Dendronotina, Arminina, Janolina, Tritonina, no Cladobranchia): WoRMS is followed and the difference is a point in data/points.json (seaslug-cladobranchia-inat, rule C5). A family of the game in no group fails the build. aphia: each family's AphiaID.
cite: WoRMS Editorial Board, World Register of Marine Species, the classification of each family (read 2026-11-16)
